# ADR-3100: A09: Alerting webhook configuration for detection 4

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

Logs without alerts delay response.

## Decision

Detection stacks SHALL set an alerting webhook configuration for detection 4 (A09-4).

## Consequences

Pages include runbook links.
